messages.subject: Error in 1:nplots
parts:
The following message appeared to me at the end of the batch analysis I was running. Has this ever happened to anyone else? What could it be?

GGIR is now creating a visual report (PDF) for each of the 78 recordings as a final step in the GGIR pipeline. This can take a while as it is done file-by-file. If you do not want the visual reports, then you can kill the process (Ctrl-C or ESC) as that will not affect the rest of the analyses and reports. To avoid this next time, change the Boolean argument 'visualreport' to FALSE. Error in 1:nplots: result would be a very long vector. Additionally, there were 13 warnings (use warnings() to see them).

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error in 1:nplots
parts:
The first half of the message in black is directed at you as GGIR and I hope the English is clear. If not, please explain what part is not clear.

The second half in red is an error the code ran into. Please try to identify what is causing it by creating a minimum reproducible example, e.g. with a small set of files in a new output folder with a minimum number of GGIR input arguments specified.

Vincent
